top_findings.title: standings computes factually wrong tables: clubs collapse by name, no season default
top_findings.evidence: core.clj:30 normalize-name strips -XX suffix so Atletico-MG/PR/GO all become 'atletico'; standings (core.clj:118-121) credits each Atletico row with all three clubs' games. _factual.json: three Atletico rows byte-identical (played=926). No season default (core.clj:118) -> nil season returns all-time totals. factual_accuracy=0.0.
top_findings.suggestion: Key standings on the full suffixed club name and give standings a default/required season.
